sources.quote: HD 131496, officially named Arcalís, is an evolved subgiant star with an orbiting exoplanet in the constellation Boötes.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 5.6 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,762 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
